whatsappMessage:
Hi Abhishek Shop team,

I noticed your local store has an active presence in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and product showcase page online.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp product inquiry, location details, aur catalog showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/abhishek

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Abhishek Ji, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Abhishek Shop) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a clean mobile catalog and direct WhatsApp customer inquiry setup for your shop in Mithapur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact product categories aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
